hooks.text: Tally found clean ground on the far side of the parish marker, twenty-two paces past the last carcass, and checked it twice; Wystan writes 'ask Tally who set the marker'. Paid when the lick-keeper's round is found to end at the marker: the carrier turned home there.

A quarter inch of new growth inside a Fixatio-anchored tin with the seal unbroken; the day book reads 'crown +¼ in sealed, 11d'. Paid at the hearing: Fixatio held what it was given, and what it was given was a running working.
'They are chapter wax and I will want them later.' Four pieces of the broken seal, dated and kept. Paid at the hearing: the pieces fit the join and prove custody.
Wystan asks Tally to keep walking and measuring: 'I want a second dataset from the same observer.' Paid when the notebook is taken from Tally's walking body, complete to the night he died.
The bulletin clerk told Tally the Night Register was a person. The cell knows its hunter only as the Night Register. Paid when the Register is folded and Malphas closes the line.
Wystan holds everything by the very edge, two-fingered, even a cup. Paid in VI: Salter sees a man holding a cup that way across the quad, notes it, and nothing follows.
Malphas's hands keep a living man's colour in a four-degree coldhouse. Paid in the hearing gallery, at the verdict, as a detail Wystan notices and never explains; never recognition.
Nuvalik got contraction out of the fourth hind's shoulder twice and did not report it; Malphas 'will discuss with her separately'. Paid when the discussion happens.
Nuvalik carries a name three people carried before her and thinks she has spent all three on this work. Paid when she sets down the name she wears in the cell and leaves; she does not inform.

Vesk's grafted fingers, the ridged yellow nails that will not stop growing; the village that put stones on its graves. Paid when he dies of his own formulation and Nuvalik lays stones on his walking body.
'Where I was raised, the sky finishes what the ground starts, and when the sky refuses, people walk out to see why.' Paid when the ravens will not come down to Tally and he walks.
Keld's minute, taken off a door handle, lucid, waiting for relief; checked every morning against a written record. It slips by a word after Cutler Row; paid when it is set right at Keld's bedside.

Wystan's Shell rests near zero saturation; free residue in a closed volume runs toward him. The dead lean to the quiet. He believes they are being sent to him; paid when he learns he is the sink and nobody sent them.
The Register token is brass, not silver, because the Night Register is not a full desk, and he has never asked to have it changed. Paid when he hands it in.
Suppression held waking and sleeping; six people alive know what Stage he is. Paid when he drops it in the death-house and the whole cordon knows.
Deming: thirty-one days of usefulness left, and Malphas has already counted them. Paid on the thirty-first day.
'In eleven weeks somebody in a room in the capital will look at the Swale line and see a bad spring.' Paid when the Logistics return publishes.
'I would prefer the file be built off a word I chose.' Every letter names Project Zombification. Paid when the Bench titles the file by the word and every thread ends in it.
'That is how they found the Hollow Shaft people. They found a name in a private correspondence.' Paid when the precedent is read into the record at Deming's hearing.

Foss reads the Division field manual's unsigned paragraph on anamnetic reading and its counters; Malphas adopts them as house rules. Paid when a moved wall makes Wystan's Called Late at Greyshaft Nine confidently wrong.
'The ninth hind is the freshest and she is the one I want.' Paid when she stands up off the table and leans to the standpipe.
Foss pays the carter in salt bars because salt bars leave no bill; the salt bar is money that can be eaten. Paid when the parish dead walk out of the pit with the bars in their purses.
Wystan's margin note: edges. Paid when the walkers erase them and he strikes the word in public.
Brack's classification: Wellspring bleed, Verdantia, no operator indicated, correct off a true measurement. Paid when the Accord's official classification stays bleed and Brack signs it again.
STAY's counter: threaten something outside the boundary; two Enforcement men have used it. Harrow is one. Paid when Wystan drops STAY to save the family on the stair.
Article XX: a death-house may not be cut; the exemption is claimed far more often than granted. Paid when Wystan holds the Wicket death-house under STAY and the dead are entered on the roll.
Deming decides that whatever the Accord asks he will not give it the hand. Paid when the Ruling chair asks and he refuses under reservation.
Malphas promises Foss release with his own name when the work is done. Paid when Foss takes a bench under his own name and informs no one.
When the Bench reserves the hand, the exhibits return to the filing party: the Ferriby tin and the chapter wax go back to Timberline. Paid when the tin is the lesson at Aetherion.

The Society tells Wystan the academies ask for field instruction; at Aetherion, Mu-jin has promised Class X the Night's Watch for 'field work, real cases'. Paid when Wystan takes the class to a real case.
At the Aetherion the hum stops at one door, the west range; Wystan stands there and turns back east. Paid when he does it again at the end of the week and goes no further.
His technique gets the hand, never the purse; Article XV prosecutes only the purse. This case inverts it. Paid when he teaches it: the hand or the purse, never both.
